**Summary:**

I identified the root cause of ticket T-5004: the API gateway pods in the edge namespace mount the `gateway-limits` ConfigMap using `subPath: limits.yaml`, which prevents automatic ConfigMap updates from propagating to the container. I verified this by examining the pod configuration and logs showing the file hash never changed despite the ConfigMap being updated at 09:10. The fix is for the ticket owner to restart the gateway deployment using `kubectl rollout restart`, which will cause the pods to reload the updated ConfigMap with the new 500 RPS limit for acme-logistics.
